content: On reception of an UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) request with an OBDInfoTypeDataIdentifier that is not an availability OBDInfoType- DataIdentifier, the Dcm module shall obtain the value of this OBDInfoTypeDataIdenti- fier by invoking all the configured Xxx_ReadData() function for every data of this OBD- InfoTypeDataIdentifier and shall return the value as response to Service 0x22.
